title: Patient Care Desk Training: Pickup Points on the Kestrel Rx Savings Club Renewal Fee (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
The Kestrel Rx Savings Club renewal fee's pickup points under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs are set by the prescription pickups the fill ledger shows dated fewer than 12 whole months before today: **12 or more** pickups earn **5 points off**, **6 to 11** pickups earn **2 points off**, and fewer earn none.

**Which pickups are counted?** The pickup entries on the patient's Prescriptions fill ledger dated fewer than 12 whole months before today. A pickup dated exactly 12 whole months before today is outside the window.

**What is a point off?** One percentage point off the enrollment fee in the renewal fee for the membership term. The renewal fee's points off are first added into one total percentage, and the enrollment fee is reduced once by that total percentage and rounded to the cent half up; the points never act one after another.

**What do the bands look like at their edges?**

| Pickups in the window | Pickup points off |
|---|---|
| 5 | 0 |
| 6 | 2 |
| 11 | 2 |
| 12 | 5 |
| 20 | 5 |

**Hypothetical:** a member with 11 pickups in the window has 2 points off; one further pickup inside the window would bring 5 points off.
